unit: Unit 13: Making Your Computer Easier to Use
title: Zooming one web page
drDigitalIntro:
Sometimes only one page is the problem, and changing the whole computer is too much.
• Every browser can zoom a single page in and out.
• The zoom control sits in the browser's toolbar and shows a percentage — 100% is normal size.
• The browser remembers the zoom for that website, so a site with small print stays readable next time.
• Common mistake: zooming so far in that the page starts wrapping oddly. Two or three steps is usually enough.

playgroundTask.goal: You zoomed a web page in

steps.say: Type citytransit.example into the address bar and press Enter.
Click the + button in the zoom control to zoom in.

drDigitalSuccess: The timetable is much easier to read now, and the browser will remember it for this site.
drDigitalHint: The zoom control is the box on the right of the browser's grey button row, showing a percentage.
